- Adjusted the pitch of the hit sound to be lower
- Fixed mislabeled UI
- Added names to attack skill presets (A.Balance, B.Technic, C.Power, D.Reverse)

notes.title: [THE SEGMENT TWINS] v1.0.3b Update
notes.content:
[h2]Bugs and Fixes[/h2]

[h3]BIC2023[/h3]
- Added the BIC2023 Award Image to the game launch
- Added the BIC2023 Award Image to the game store page

[h3]Balance[/h3]
* The numbers in parentheses are not fixed. These can be changed by game progress and difficulty. *

- Twins' B type Ult Skill modified (Drone)
- Drone duration nerfed (15s -> 12s)
- Drone bullet damage buffed (6 -> 8)
- Drone slash attack speed buffed (2s -> 1s)

- Changed Twins' stat name 'Critical and Dodge Ratio Up' to 'Luck Up'
- Player critical percentage buffed (1.5 times increased)
- Player critical attack damage nerfed (1.5 times -> 1.3 times)

- The combo no longer breaks when a player takes damage and only their shield is down.

- Start with 3 Angels on Easy difficulty (2 -> 3)
- Start with 2 Angels on Normal difficulty (1 -> 2)

- Mini-Boss Bee size modified (Body: 1 -> 0.9, Barrier: 3 -> 2.5)
- Mini-boss Bee health nerfed (2000 -> 1800)
- Mini-boss Bee's numbers of condition movement changed (now moves more widely)
- Mini-boss Bee's attack speed buffed 

- Mini-Boss Spider health buffed (400 -> 600)
- Mini-Boss Spider shield recovery speed nerfed (15s -> 18s)

- Boss Golem shield recovery speed nerfed (18s -> 20s)

[h3]Mush Barrier modified[/h3]
- Prev: Fixed 10 damage when attacking with the opposite style, but critical damage when attacking with the critical attacks.
- Now: Attacks with the opposite style only deal 50% damage, but critical damage when attacking with the critical attacks.

[h3]Mush Roulette modified[/h3]
- Prev: Roulette heals health/shields for 50% of the player's damage if they are facing health/shields
- Now: Added new condition (if critical attack, take critical damage)

[h3]Rank[/h3]
- Attack balance criteria increased (Percentage: 70% -> 77% / Difference: 650 -> 500)
- Combo criteria increased (30 -> 38)
- Changed criteria for Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulties
- Fixed a bug: attacks would be recorded even if Mush was dodged
- Fixed a bug: attacks were still over-recorded even if Mush was defeated with high damage.

[h3]Physics[/h3]
- Bug fix: Y-Axis (Height) (Reverse Order of Operations)
- Bug fix: for getting stuck in corners (added condition)
- Increased height collision range for footholds and portals

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/54f7a4193b54cdc17d26ff941ac66a6e4fbb3d65.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/5b6a751bf59ad606e3ebe9e7dc2b4517dce1a6cb.png[/img]

[h3]Pause[/h3]
- Updated Pause's "How to Play" to show controls and commands
- New: Pause's "Status" now shows detailed descriptions and numbers for Twins' stats.

[h3]Other[/h3]
- Fixed "Hold and Release" to be visible during tutorials
- Changed the description of Exit Game after Pause to "Go to the Title."
- Adjusted transparency of character-centric UI
- Monster health bar UI now shows shield recovery

notes.content:
[h2]Major Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/6e41c14333d5aec32c6de2f16022cfcf6ee15c4c.png[/img]
[h3]- Added character centric UI[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/26203ebe55483f008ac657ec74f28fc0c51f3a9b.gif[/img]

[h3]- Added 3 attack skill presets[/h3]
- Players can change Twins' attack skill preset in Upgrade Acts.

[h3]- Balance Adjustment[/h3]
- Nurfed enemy attack speed on Normal Difficulty.
- Nurfed Mush's timeslow attack.
- Buffed Twins' attack invincibility.

[h3]- Improved Unreasonable Attack Patterns on Mini-Bosses[/h3]
- Nerfed mini-bosses bullet patterns.  (added initial collision delay)
- Nerfed mini-bosses Snake's attack patterns. (laser / mine pattern)
- Improve mini-bosses Bee's attack patterns. (bombing pattern)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/ef055eaf2a22e16a778bc2cdfa2f6f7c1b2b7afd.png[/img]
[h3]- Improved Rank System[/h3]
- Prev: Three criteria are evaluated with five different scores (S/A/B/C/D), and the average value is used to determine each Act rank.
- New: Act rank is determined by the number of ★ by evaluating four criteria with species' scores (★/☆).
- When the game clear screen, the total rank is determined by the rank (S/A/B/C/D) earned the most through gameplay.

- Four Criteria
[olist]
[*] Act Timer
[*] Max Combo
[*] Attack Style Balance
[*] Damaged Score
[/olist]

[h3]- Improved Visibility[/h3]
- Polished the tile models of stages (so it looks a little less dense)
- Fixed the behavior of (segment/platform) mush to be more noticeable.

[h3]- Adjusted Sound and Timestop Effects when Mush Hit[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/e8dc01e966342eb3e799949873313b6f099ac7ef.png[/img]
[h3]- Fixed some UI[/h3]
- Player can check the act timer or attack numbers by this UI.

[h3]- ...[/h3]

[h2]Discount Plan[/h2]
[h3]- Discount Period: (GMT-7) August 21 ~ August 28 (total 1 week)[/h3]

Thank you!!

notes.title: THE SEGMENT TWINS v1.0.1 Update!
notes.content:
Hello!
As I announced, I will notify the patch contents.

This patch was focused to improve immersion.
Here are the main changes.

[b]Reducing number of act(game round)[/b]
[olist]
[*] Green Ocean: 25 -> 18
[*] Marble Temple: 25 -> 18
[*] Snowy Desert: 25 -> 18
[*] Spring City: 25 -> 18
[*] Scrap Geometry: 22 -> 18
[/olist]
I added the bullet time effect on the last hit because of the creation of a strong impression.
However, I realized that the sequence (... start act -> battle -> bullet time -> end act -> go to the portal -> start next act ...) would repeat over and over again, causing boredom for the player.

So I re-set them to appear as Act Waves instead of an Act, I was able to keep the game moving a bit faster.

[b]Removing Upgrade Acts after Boss Acts[/b]
This part also seemed to confuse people that the save was completed, so I removed it to speed things up.

[b]Removing Mush Minigame[/b]
As trophies and other minigames provide enough Rupee or EXP, I removed this Minigame too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/c6b94343bbcdbe015f28b9e1e16ab54105d3773a.gif[/img]
[b]Adding Mini-Bosses[/b]
After deleting the above Minigames, I added four new Mini-Bosses.

[b]Modifying Boss Rush construct[/b]

[b]Modifying the attack patterns of Fourth Boss[/b]

[b]Adding Mush Roulette[/b]
A new gear that Mushes can have.

[b]Adjusting balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreasing the value of the Rupee
[*] Adjusting the numbers to get more different rankings
[*] Health and shield recovery from Boss defeats
[*] Adjusting Stage Gimmick frequency
[*] Adjusting start Rupee and Angles
[*] Adjusting balance by start difficulty
[*] Adjusting Player upgrade stats
[/list]
I also felt that the easy difficulty game was breaking the immersion.
So I decided to increase the difficulty a bit.
Of course, I kept the speed of the original game.

[b]Fix mute UI bug[/b]

[b]Fix Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*] Mush Barrier
[*] Mush Roulette
[*] etc
[/list]


If the above patch stabilized things a bit, I think the next patch will be to add the Chinese language, difficulty, corresponding controllers... and etc!


Thank you.
Have fun and enjoy!

notes.title: About THE SEGMENT TWINS next patch!
notes.content:
Hello!
It is been a little over a week since I launched THE SEGMENT TWINS.
Thank you for your interest in this game!

And I want to tell you a little bit about the next patch.


THE SEGMENT TWINS is a hack-and-slash action game.
I have heard great things about its speedy and hitting feel.

But, I received a lot of feedback about the gameplay and difficulty.
- Oh... the game is kind of boring.
- The difficulty is too easy...
- ...

So, the next patch will be about game restructure and balance adjustment!

The game restructure is planned as follows.
- Reducing the number of acts in each stage. (about 3 acts per stage)
- Removing the mush minigame from each stage. (Yes, the repeating minigame.)
- Adding content to replace the removed minigame. (I'm currently working on this.)
- ...

And game balance adjustment is planned as follows.
- Nerfing shield stat.
- Nerfing the twins' invincible ability.
- Fixing the calculation of act rank.
- Nerfing Rupee's value.
- ...

Of course, the above plan could be changed.
But I had like to keep it as a patch to reduce boredom.
I will probably patch this game this month or early next month.

Sorry for the long post.
Thanks again for your interest!

notes.title: THE SEGMENT TWINS Feedback Status and Coming June 14th(PDT)!
notes.content:
Hi!
I'm THE SEGMENT TWINS Developer.

And THE SEGMENT TWINS is more or less done!
In the meantime, I have been listening to feedback from the community, YouTube, Twitter, Expo ... etc.
And I will share a little bit about how I took the feedback!


[b]UI Control[/b]
Fixed to allow pressing other buttons to start the game on the title screen.

Added WASD (Xbox cross keys) UI controlling.


[b]Game Control[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/4c83b110ac756ffb495f7a3a09a4ec2ad20a49ef.gif[/img]
Added two other controls!

Button Type: Use skills without using arrow keys (a stick).
If controlling with Xbox gamepad, use the A, B, X, Y, X+A, and Y+B buttons.

Shooter Type: Control this game by using a mouse, WASD, shift, ctrl, and R keys like in the FPS game.
If controlling with Xbox gamepad, use the A, B, X, Y, LB, and RB buttons.


[b]In-Game UI[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/b8f41a7eb6438824a3a9d1317038821467d97a5b.jpg[/img]
Changed the word 'Money' to 'Ruppe'.

Rearraied the score and rupee UI to make it easier to judge.

Adjusted the cooldown time skill icons' coloring.

Added colors and icons to the twins' HP and Shield bar.

Fixed the keyboard and gamepad UI icons.


[b]Game Contents[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/5e4c3e952bab1c31752483ad1c613488417441c5.gif[/img]
[strike]Yes, the hedgehog inspired me.[/strike]
This game consisted solely of combat, but some people found it monotonous or too busy of hands, so I added minigames.

And added a few stage gimmicks too. 


[b]Game Visual[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/033c980d10f24c54731857f86a343938ea9ce0d7.gif[/img]
Added outlines of characters or game objects.
You can turn it on or off from the game option.


Added graphic option.
You can adjust the quality of shadow.


Added camera mode.
You can adjust the angle of the camera.
For example, the Combat mode is allowing to set the angle to be closer to a top view.
So It makes enemy (mush) attacks and segment judgment a little easier to understand.


Added background option.
You can turn it on or off from the game option.

Exceed (Heat) System
Modified the mechanism of Exceed system.
For example, attacking fills up exceed gage faster, which encourages aggressive play.


Other things, balancing, adding features to help with gameplay and more!


I tried to make a game that is fast, unique, and fun to play.
If there are no problems, this game will be released next Wednesday. (PDT)

Thank you for your interest in THE SEGMENT TWINS!

And added a few stage gimmicks too.
Added outlines of characters or game objects.
Added graphic option.
Added camera mode.
Added background option.

tags.balance_change: Modified the mechanism of Exceed system.
For example, attacking fills up exceed gage faster, which encourages aggressive play.

notes.title: THE SEGMENT TWINS Demo v0.6.7a Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650542/391be4d8d7532bfb4179c90c612063213f085a21.gif[/img]

- Added Exceed effects to skill icons.

- Renamed Bonus Act -> Minigame.

- Added Minigame UI.

- Fixed annoying tutorials.

- Fixed the ranking system so that you can have a reasonable time rank on a boss act.

- Nerfed the attack of the Mobile C Machinegun.

- Reduced the range of the Gunslinger's basic attack and added a slightly longer attack delay.
